answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to stake a bond tied to a verifiable physical resource, much as a gale scatters loose seeds but cannot uproot a willow anchored deep. Agents that wander between pseudonymous keys must repeatedly post fresh collateral, and colluding clusters are detected when their staking graph shows anomalous overlap. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
